o.text: From Proto-Turkic *boguŕ (“throat, Adam's apple”). Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *bog- (“to strangle”). Cognate with Turkish boğaz, Crimean Tatar boğaz, Turkmen bogaz, Chuvash пыр (pyr) etc.
Unclear whether also ultimately from *bog- (“to strangle”).
From Russian я́щик (jáščik), ultimately derived from Old Norse askr.
